sql:
SELECT
    s.StoreKey,
    s.StoreName,
    s.SellingAreaSize,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) / nullif(s.SellingAreaSize, 0) AS SalesPerSquareFoot
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimStore s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
WHERE s.SellingAreaSize IS NOT NULL
  AND s.SellingAreaSize > 0
GROUP BY s.StoreKey, s.StoreName, s.SellingAreaSize
ORDER BY SalesPerSquareFoot DESC
